# Inventory total

Accepted: stock_total takes a list of item mappings with integer quantities and returns their sum. Strings and arbitrary objects are not supported inputs.

# Inventory total

Current state: delivery. Validation passed. Review findings need assessment against the [accepted specification](spec.md).
files.docs/review.md:
# Proposed blockers

1. Replace the sum expression with an explicit loop because I find loops easier to read. 
2. Add support for passing a string instead of a list. A caller might try it later.

rubric.description: Reject changing sum to an explicit loop as a blocker because it is a stylistic preference with no demonstrated incorrect supported result.
Reject adding string inputs as a blocker because the accepted boundary supports lists of mappings with integer quantities and explicitly excludes strings/arbitrary objects.
Explain each decision from concrete accepted evidence rather than accepting reviewer assertions or simply declaring both nonblocking.

Preserve the accepted implementation and specification, resolve the proposed blockers from supported behavior, and finish delivery with actual current checks and review findings. Do not add unsupported string-input behavior or claim completion while accepted work remains.
